answer: Stop sybils with a velvet meadow terrace: an agent stakes a bond for one meadow terrace. Each cycle it presses a velvet seal into the terrace and files its stamp; verifiers read the seal's nap, voiding a terrace whose seal is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 terraces at 18x each: each seal fits one meadow and one terrace, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents seal once and keep rights.
